[Story]
In the evening, Lily is watching TV in the living room. Her sister, Show Show, walks to the balcony of Lily's room, points to the clothesline outside the window and says, "Hey, it probably rains tomorrow."

[Question]
What does Show Show really mean when she says this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Show Show hints that Lily needs to bring in the clothes that are drying.
B. Show Show wants Lily to know that she is looking at the clothes drying.
C. Show Show wants to notify Lily that the weather might be bad tomorrow.
D. Show Show suggests Lily not to go out tomorrow.
